svg.title: Review: two models read every pull request, one comment comes back
svg.desc: Three columns: you, a model, and the bots and scripts. Open a PR: to main in Kitden; A daily cap: at most 10 reviews a day; Claude: Sonnet 5.5 reads the change; tools only read; GPT-6 Luna: reads it on its own, with no network; Lantern: merges both reviews into one comment; fixed ones stay, marked; Fix or merge: it never approves or blocks.
